slice_preflight.method: Exact decimal-centered triangle-plane intersection; endpoint weld tolerance 1e-7 mm; Shapely closed polygons with odd-even rings; not extrusion toolpaths

overhang_preflight.criterion: down-facing triangles >45 degrees from vertical, excluding build-plate bottom

limitations: Numerical mesh/slice checks do not guarantee adhesion, strength or support-free printing.
Supports need assessment under the portal soffit, tower undercroft, stair flights, fins, balcony ledges and bridge interface.
Color-only window and trim boundaries are actual face assignments, not holes. Fine features may require enlargement or resin; louvers and rails are model-thickened.
Exterior model with open portal and approximate visible bridges; no full interior halls, basement, site grading, structural simulation or exact real-world scale.
